subject: infoschema: replace the btree library for v2 implementation (#58466)
summary: Reviewed the infoschema v2 btree swap (`tidwall/btree` -> `google/btree`) including the new atomic-pointer + clone-on-write update pattern and updated iteration APIs. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in correctness, metadata consistency, or concurrency for infoschema/DDLv2 behavior in this commit relative to its first parent; later upstream/master follow-ups removed the hard panic on rare CAS conflicts in btree updates (#58815).
